# The REFINERY

> The REFINERY supports youth robotics in Fort Wayne and Northeast Indiana, helping FIRST
> teams start, grow, and succeed with funding, tools, space, and training.

## Mission

The REFINERY exists so that no FIRST robotics team in Northeast Indiana has to build its
infrastructure alone. We provide the funding, parts, tools, facilities, training, and
community that let teams start, grow, and succeed.

## About

The REFINERY is a nonprofit robotics makerspace and regional infrastructure organization in
Fort Wayne, Indiana, supporting FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) and FIRST Tech Challenge
(FTC) teams across Northeast Indiana. It operates as a program of BioNanomics, which holds
the 501(c)(3) status that donations are received under.

Young robotics teams have long faced the same challenge: building a competitive program takes
far more than a robot, and few schools or communities can build all of that infrastructure
alone. The REFINERY grew out of a shared makerspace built to close that gap, and has since
evolved from just a physical facility into a regional infrastructure organization supporting
many teams across the region.

## What The REFINERY provides

- **Team launch and organizational support** — helping new and developing teams build the
  organizational foundation they need to last.
- **Funding and financial infrastructure** — moving money to the teams that need it.
- **Parts and inventory** — a shared pool teams draw on instead of each buying their own.
- **Tools and fabrication** — machines and shop capacity most teams cannot own individually.
- **Facilities and field access** — shop space and practice field time.
- **Training and technical support** — workshops and hands-on technical help.
- **Community and student experience** — events, mentoring, and the wider regional community.

## Reach

Across Northeast Indiana, The REFINERY has backed 15 robotics teams, put tools and mentors in
front of roughly 200 students, helped launch 5 new teams from scratch, and moved $75,000 in
funding to the teams that needed it.

## Where we serve

The REFINERY serves 12 counties in Northeast Indiana, including communities that don't have a
team yet, and helps schools and community groups there start one: Adams (Decatur), Allen
(Fort Wayne), DeKalb (Auburn), Grant (Marion, Fairmount), Huntington (Huntington), Kosciusko
(Warsaw), LaGrange (LaGrange), Noble (Albion, Kendallville), Steuben (Angola), Wabash
(Wabash), Wells (Bluffton), and Whitley (Columbia City). The About page lists every incorporated
city and town in each county.

## Pages

- [Home](https://refineryrobotics.org/): What The REFINERY does and who it serves.
- [What We Do](https://refineryrobotics.org/what-we-do/): The full set of support offered to
  teams — funding, parts, tools, facilities, training, community, and contributions back to
  the wider FIRST community.
- [Programs & Events](https://refineryrobotics.org/programs-events/): Upcoming events, the
  public events calendar, and ongoing programs.
- [Monster Match](https://refineryrobotics.org/programs-events/monster-match/): An offseason
  FRC competition and college and career fair with trick or treating, free and open to the
  public, on 31 October 2026 at Wayne High School in Fort Wayne.
- [News](https://refineryrobotics.org/news/): Updates from The REFINERY, its teams, and
  robotics coverage from across the region.
- [Get Involved](https://refineryrobotics.org/get-involved/): How to volunteer, partner as an
  organization or business, start or host a team, give, or find a team for a student.
- [About](https://refineryrobotics.org/about/): History, the teams and partners involved, the
  people behind it, and the Fort Wayne facility.
- [Meet the Teams](https://refineryrobotics.org/about/teams/): The FRC and FTC teams The
  REFINERY supports across Northeast Indiana.
- [Donate](https://refineryrobotics.org/donate/): What giving funds, and how to give.

  visits are by appointment.
